findings_assessment: The REPORT's finding on B21 l.1110-1112 is well founded. K = J⁺_N(𝒞)∩J⁻_N(q) is compact in N, but ∂𝒮 is closed only in M. The shaft wall is unbounded in τ, so its image can accumulate in N ∖ f(Reg M), and K ∩ ∂𝒮 is not known closed in K. The printed argument never bounds the BTZ ray below q. The file proves that bound (exists_bound_axis) and truncates the spear. The finding on 'max c⁻¹(K′)' (l.1113) is also correct: the exit point must be the last point of the first stretch inside the spear. Both are findings for the author, not defects of the file.
